consumer: The engine reload path (item::reload / gun ammo-option disambiguation) asking: does the wielded gun have exactly one unambiguous compatible ammo source so no ammo-selection menu is raised?
scope: All reachable compatible ammo sources for the wielded gun (inventory plus adjacent/container ammo the reload routine searches), reduced through the engine's own compatibility-and-disambiguation rule to a single-vs-multiple verdict.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items dumps raw carried item fields (type_id, charges, count_by_charges, location) with no ammo-compatibility match and no reload-option computation.
divergence: Wielded rifle plus two distinct compatible ammo types in inventory: the engine would raise a selection menu (ambiguous), but the raw carried_items dump lets the frontend re-derive 'compatible ammo present' and wrongly auto-reload, or conversely miss an adjacent-container ammo source the engine would have offered.
